cases.paragraph: A machine is considered overheating if its internal temperature stays above 90 degrees Celsius for more than ten minutes. Overheating can trigger an automatic shutdown. A blocked ventilation filter can increase temperature, but it does not by itself prove overheating. Machine M7 has a blocked ventilation filter. Its internal temperature reached 94 degrees Celsius for twelve minutes during the last run. The shutdown controller did not activate because the monitoring cable was disconnected.

queries.answer: No proof establishes sufficiency from that condition alone. The relevant rules also require: (IsA $m machine), (HasInternalTemperature $m $temp), (GreaterThan $temp 90celsius), (HasTemperatureDuration $m $duration), (GreaterThan $duration 10minute).

cases.paragraph: A student qualifies for the merit scholarship if the student has a GPA of at least 3.8 and has completed at least 40 volunteer hours. A student can be considered for the leadership scholarship if the student led a recognized club, but leadership consideration does not imply merit scholarship qualification. Lena has a GPA of 3.9 and completed 45 volunteer hours. She did not lead a recognized club.

cases.paragraph: A server is considered compromised if unauthorized login is detected and sensitive files are accessed. A failed login attempt may indicate risk, but it does not prove compromise. Server Atlas recorded an unauthorized login from an unknown IP address. Sensitive payroll files were accessed during the same session. No malware alert was triggered.

cases.paragraph: A field needs irrigation if soil moisture is below 20 percent and no rain is forecast within two days. Yellow leaves can indicate stress, but yellow leaves alone do not prove irrigation is needed. Field Delta has soil moisture of 18 percent. No rain is forecast for the next two days. Some plants have yellow leaves. The irrigation pump is not broken.

cases.paragraph: A traveler is ready for international departure if the traveler has a valid passport and an approved visa. A booked ticket does not by itself make the traveler ready for departure. Hana has a valid passport. Her visa application has been approved. She booked a ticket. She has not completed online check-in.
